moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins today, August 21st, with Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City in the opening fixture.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / Sky Sports

angles.name: Opening Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's back! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off today with Arsenal taking on Coventry City. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Coventry's Return
angles.copy: A huge day for Coventry City as they return to the Premier League after 25 years, facing champions Arsenal. What a start!

angles.name: Weekend Fixture Preview
angles.copy: After today's opener, the Premier League weekend is packed: Hull v Man Utd, Newcastle v Liverpool, Man City v Bournemouth. Which game are you most excited for?

moments.title: F1 Dutch Grand Prix Weekend
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 Heineken Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort begins today, August 21st, with Practice 1 and Sprint Qualifying, leading up to Sunday's race.

angles.name: Lights Out Zandvoort
angles.copy: F1 is back in action! The Dutch Grand Prix weekend starts today with Practice 1 and Sprint Qualifying. Get ready for the Zandvoort madness!

angles.name: Sprint Race Format
angles.copy: It's a Sprint weekend at Zandvoort! Today features Sprint Qualifying, setting the grid for tomorrow's Sprint Race. What are your thoughts on the format?

angles.name: Race Day Anticipation
angles.copy: The F1 Dutch Grand Prix race is just two days away! Who's your pick for the win at Zandvoort on Sunday?

moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals return next weekend, August 27-30, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.copy: Just one week until Reading & Leeds! Who are you most excited to see on the huge lineup?

angles.name: Headliner Buzz

angles.name: Last Minute Tickets
